reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis relies on graphene layers at grain boundaries to arrest cracks without disrupting the martensitic transformation, but graphene is unlikely to survive high-temperature processing, will react with the alloy, and would severely embrittle rather than toughen the material.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and comparative, but the falsification criterion is arbitrary (15-20% improvement) and the hypothesis is so physically implausible that the test would not be needed to reject it.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it proposes a physically unworkable solution (graphene in a metallic alloy) that would not survive synthesis and would degrade both mechanical and functional properties.
